artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be an odd prime. For an integer $a$ coprime to $p$, let $\left(\frac{a}{p}\right)$ denote the Legendre symbol. Use the multinomial coefficient $\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k} = \frac{(4k)!}{(k!)^4}$.

Prove or disprove the following congruences.

(i) The base congruences modulo $p^2$:
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-8)^k} \equiv \left(\frac{-2}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-512)^k} \pmod{p^2},$$
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{16^k} \equiv \left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{256^k} \pmod{p^2}.$$

Moreover, if $p \equiv 1 \pmod{4}$, then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-8)^k} \equiv \left(\frac{2}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-512)^k} \equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{648^k} \pmod{p^3};$$
and if $p \equiv 1 \pmod{3}$, then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{16^k} \equiv \left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{256^k} \equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{(-144)^k} \pmod{p^3}.$$

(ii) Further, if $p \equiv 1, 3 \pmod{8}$, then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{(-64)^k} \equiv \left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{256^k} \pmod{p^3};$$
and if $p \equiv 1, 2, 4 \pmod{7}$, then
$$\left(\frac{-1}{p}\right)\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\binom{2k}{k}^3 \equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^3}{4096^k} \equiv \sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}}{(-3969)^k} \pmod{p^3}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches show extensive recent activity on Sun's supercongruence conjectures involving cubed central binomial coefficients and multinomial coefficients $\binom{4k}{k,k,k,k}$ modulo $p^2$ and $p^3$, with several conjectures proved by Guo, Liu, Mao and others. However, no source directly confirming a complete proof of all the specific congruences listed (with rational parameters $-8, -512, 16, 256, 648, -144, -64, 4096, -3969$) was located, so the status of this particular package of conjectures could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: A Generalized Supercongruence of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Proves a generalized supercongruence of Z.-W. Sun involving binomial coefficients modulo prime powers.
status_evidence.claim: Many Sun supercongruence conjectures of similar shape have been proved, but the specific list above is not directly addressed.

status_evidence.title: Proof of a supercongruence conjectured by Z.-H. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Guo proves supercongruences for Franel-type sums conjectured by Sun.
status_evidence.claim: Related supercongruences have been confirmed, but not necessarily this exact conjecture A36.
